title: s500-generic-45: Letter and word selective SEEG responses in the ventral occipito-temporal cortex, fast periodic visual stimulation (Lochy et al., 2018) (derivative)
description: Stereo-EEG recordings from 37 patients with refractory epilepsy at the University Hospital of Nancy, collected during fast periodic visual stimulation to probe letter and word selectivity in the ventral occipito-temporal cortex. Pseudofonts, nonwords or pseudowords were presented at 10 Hz with a real word every fifth item (2 Hz), so that selective responses appear at 2 Hz and its harmonics. This derivative release repackages the authors' Letswave files, low-pass filtered at 40 Hz and cut into sequences, in BIDS format with electrode coordinates in Talairach and MNI space.
methods_description: Micromed recordings were imported into Letswave 5 and low-pass filtered at 40 Hz (Butterworth order 4). Each sequence was cut from 2 s after onset to about 68 s, an integer number of 2 Hz cycles, and sequences of one condition were merged. They were then repackaged as BrainVision files with events.tsv and electrodes.tsv derived from the release's coordinate tables.
